events.verdict: Mobley (CLE) reaches in and makes contact with Johnson (BKN) that does not affect his SQBR in transition.
Okoro (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Johnson's (BKN) path to the basket and Johnson loses control of the ball on his own accord.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Okoro (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Okoro never makes contact with the ball and Johnson (BKN) is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds. Play resumes with Cleveland possession.
Johnson (BKN) shuffles forwards slightly while Strus (CLE) is airborne and the ensuing contact during the driving shot attempt between the two players is marginal.
Williams' (BKN) hand slides off of the ball and on to Okoro's (CLE) wrist, affecting his ability to control the rebound.
Claxton (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball to dislodge the rebound away from Allen (CLE).
Strus (CLE) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt. Any marginal contact with Johnson's arm occurs prior to his gather and upward shooting motion.
Johnson's (BKN) shot attempt goes out of bounds.
Garland (CLE) and Johnson (BKN) briefly engage and disengage during the screen.
Strus (CLE) briefly rests his hand on Thomas's (BKN) body without extending it into him during his driving shot attempt.

Replay review of the foul called on Garland (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. The illegal contact on the play is initiated by Williams (BKN), who wraps his arms around Garland and pulls him before Garland pushes off.
Johnson (BKN) commits a take foul on Strus (CLE).
Allen (CLE) jumps and turns into Johnson (BKN), initiating body contact that affects his driving shot attempt.
Garland (CLE) runs directly into Martin (BKN), who is in a legally established position and allows him to move freely.
Martin (BKN) commits a take foul on Strus (CLE).
Garland (CLE) legally contests Thomas's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Johnson (BKN) makes clean contact with the ball to steal it away from Mobley (CLE).
